changelog:
Initial release of the Conduct Patent Research skill.

- Implements a structured, four-stage patent research workflow from technical problem framing to deliverable reporting.
- Integrates with PatSnap’s advanced search, patent briefing, deep mining, and global core database connectors.
- Guides users through problem/solution input, iterative search decomposition, and concept expansion.
- Labels evidence, observations, legal signals, and preserves comprehensive search provenance.
- Outputs decision-ready patent research in HTML and/or DOCX formats.
summary: Conduct an evidence-backed patent research program from a technical problem and preliminary solution through iterative patent searching, technology-route analysis, project novelty pre-screening, FTO-oriented risk screening, competitor monitoring, recent-publication surveillance, and self-contained HTML plus DOCX reporting. Use when a user asks for patent research, project-initiation novelty review, technical-route analysis, patent risk screening, competitor patent tracking, or a comprehensive patent-search report.
